item: E1a, first part: R0 and the builder checks (a) to (e)
plan: bioinf2027/plans/E1_design.md, Sections 7, 9 and 21 to 23 (Section 23.4 fixes R0)
statistic: log1p(max(0, anderson_ksamp([a, b]).statistic)), scipy default midrank variant
check_a: external mode, 27 perturbed against 788 pooled control cells, median of the valid draws before the 20-draw rule, against y_primary
check_b: source mode, all perturbed cells of a row against all control cells of its batch, against the stored label
check_c: external mode against source mode, same cells
check_d: control indices drawn after the perturbed draw, every pool size from n_pert + 1 to the largest pool of each side, n_pert 27 and 10
check_e: gf_mu_pert minus gf_mu_nt against gf_z_emb on every row and dimension; mean of each batch's cached control-cell embeddings against gf_mu_nt

r0.draw_order: per seed one generator: slots first (the row's batch's control cells, ascending, or all pooled control cells, ascending), then 788 control cells from the pooled set without the slot cells, ascending
r0.rows: 10 slots: all modelled rows; 27 slots: rows with at least 27 perturbed cells
r0.units: split by Flex run, at each slot level; units with fewer than 15 target genes are descriptive
r0.component: sqrt(max(0, SD^2 batch-own - SD^2 pooled-draw)) / scale; scales: SD of the existing VCC label on the unit's rows (recomputed per replicate), SD of the existing 27-cell label on RPE1 and on K562-essential (fixed); the scale giving the largest point component is kept in every replicate
r0.ten_slot_component: understated (no 10-cell label exists); enters only the batch-local condition
r0.D: Spearman(batch-own null, B1) - Spearman(pooled-draw null, B1); B1 = pooled control mean of the target gene, external mode
r0.abs_D_bounds: upper = max(|lo|, |hi|); lower = 0 if the interval contains 0, else min(|lo|, |hi|)

reading.favours the batch-local pair: read first: any unit that enters, either level: lower bound of the component or of |D| at least 0.25
reading.favours the pooled pair: the batch-local condition does not hold, and in every unit that enters: upper bound of |D| below 0.10 at both levels and upper bound of the 27-slot component below 0.10

r0.depth_trigger: control cells, totals over the genes VCC shares with the screen (Ensembl identifiers), medians compared; G1-DT is built for a screen if the larger median exceeds the smaller by more than a factor of 1.5
